stories.title: DOJ arrests three people in connection with Minneapolis church protests
stories.summary: The DOJ has arrested at least two people in connection with protests at a Minneapolis church last weekend. One of the pastors is said to lead the local ICE field office.

stories.title: Death of a detainee at an ICE detention center in Texas is ruled a homicide
stories.summary: The El Paso County medical examiner classified the death of a 55-year-old Cuban ICE detainee as homicide.

stories.title: Pentagon vows to end 'woke distractions' at military's independent newspaper
stories.summary: The editor-in-chief of Stars and Stripes responds to a Defense Department announcement that it will assume greater control over the military newspaper.

stories.title: The week in science: Ice, parents' disgust and penguins adapting to climate change
stories.summary: Emily Kwong and Regina Barber of NPR's Short Wave podcast talk about the mysterious structure of ice, parents' heightened tolerance for disgust, and how penguins are adapting to climate change.

stories.title: Winter storm preparations underway across the South
stories.summary: Across the South and Northeast, communities are preparing for snow and ice from a massive winter storm expected to move through this weekend.

stories.title: The influence of the sleeper hit novel 'The Correspondence'
stories.summary: Virginia Evans' debut novel, The Correspondent, was a sleeper hit of 2025. The book tells the story of a divorced woman in her 70s through her letters to her friends, kids, loved ones and strangers.
